definitions.short: Molek (i.e. king), the chief deity of the Ammonites
definitions.full: H4432. Molek מֹ֫לֶךְ proper name, of a divinity Molech ( ᵐ5 Μολοχ , ᵑ9 Moloch ) (= מֶלֶךְ i.e. ( divine ) King , with vowels of בּשֶׁת to denote abhorrence, Hoffm ZAW iii. 1883, 124 RS Semitic i. 353; 2nd ed. 372 ; compare Hoffm GG Abh. xxxvi. 1890 a (May, 1889), 25 ; Phoenician proper name, of divinity מלך Milk , in proper names compare Bloch, Dr Dt.222 f. ); — with article ׳הַמּ : — the god to whom Israel sacrificed children with fire (in valley of Hinnom); מּ לַ בָּנֵשׁ ׳העביר 2Kin 23:10 ; לַמּ ׳העביר Jer 32:35 (|| הַבַּעַל ), Lev 18:21 (H); לַמּ ׳נתן 20:2-3 , 4 (H); more Generally הַמּ אַחֲרֵי ׳לִזְנוֺת 20:5 (H). In 1Kin 11:7 read probably מִלְכֹּם , q. v.
